ocr.notes: minor: 'assented to by his opponent', not 'his associates'

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that after the police broke up their fight, Tom Allen and J. C. Gallagher signed new articles to fight next Tuesday within fifty miles of Kansas City.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE MISSOURI REPUBLICAN ST. LOUIS, NOVEMBER 3, 1870

facts.fact: Gallagher visited Allen at his saloon on Washington avenue and proposed fighting in Louisiana, Kansas, Arkansas or Kentucky; Allen agreed to any of them
places: Allen's saloon, Washington avenue, St. Louis

facts.fact: Allen and J. C. Gallagher signed new articles to fight the following Tuesday within fifty miles of Kansas City, with other conditions unchanged and no excursion
places: saloon on Locust street between Fourth and Fifth, St. Louis

notes: A later conference at the Broadgauge saloon (Allen, Kelly, Mike McCoole) made no changes; Allen expected a different agreement because Gallagher's backers feared losing their money.
